parameters.content:
## 1. Intake
Databricks job webhooks, Azure Monitor (ADF) alerts and generic JSON arrive on `POST /webhook/dataops-alert` (basic auth). Normalise maps them to one schema; Classify applies ordered severity rules.

## 2. Idempotency + de-dup + log
`alerting.register_alert()` runs in one Postgres call under an advisory lock: replays are detected by event_id, repeats inside the window are SUPPRESSED, everything is written to `alert_log`. The webhook is acknowledged after this.

## 3. Route by decision
PAGE: Slack + Jira + email. NOTIFY: Slack + Jira. RESOLVE: Slack. DIGEST: picked up by the daily digest workflow. Branches run top to bottom (Slack, email, then Jira); each channel retries 3x and a failure is recorded per channel instead of blocking the others.

nodes.name: Normalise Payload
nodes.notes: Databricks / Azure Monitor / generic payload -> canonical alert + fingerprint + event_id.

nodes.name: Classify Severity
nodes.notes: Ordered rules (first match wins) -> severity, rule id, reason, route, summary.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $env.LLM_MODEL || 'gpt-4o-mini', temperature: 0.2, max_tokens: 160, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: 'You summarise data pipeline alerts for an on-call data engineer in at most two sentences: what failed and the first thing to check. Use only the facts given.' }, { role: 'user', content: JSON.stringify({ pipeline: $json.pipeline, environment: $json.environment, severity: $json.severity, event: $json.source_event, detail: $json.error_message, rule: $json.severity_reason }) } ] }) }}

nodes.name: LLM Summary (optional)
nodes.notes: Disabled by default. Enable to replace the rule-based summary with an LLM one. Errors continue, so the LLM never blocks an alert.

nodes.name: Attach Summary
nodes.notes: Keeps the rule-based summary unless the LLM node produced text.

nodes.name: Dedup + Log Alert
nodes.notes: Atomic: idempotency on event_id, de-dup window per fingerprint, insert into alerting.alert_log.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ alert_id: Number($json.alert_id), decision: $json.decision, replay: $json.is_replay, occurrence: $json.occurrence, severity: $json.alert.severity, rule: $json.alert.severity_rule, fingerprint: $json.alert.fingerprint }) }}

nodes.name: Acknowledge Sender
nodes.notes: Responds once the alert is durably logged; fan-out continues after the response.

nodes.name: Build Notifications
nodes.notes: Slack blocks, Jira fields and email bodies; sets `action` (NONE for suppress/replay/log-only).

nodes.name: Slack: Post Alert
nodes.notes: Slack incoming webhook (the mock receiver locally).

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ fields: Object.assign({}, $json.jira.fields, { project: { key: $env.JIRA_PROJECT_KEY || 'DATA' }, issuetype: { name: $env.JIRA_ISSUE_TYPE || 'Bug' } }) }) }}

nodes.name: Jira: Create Issue
nodes.notes: Jira REST v2 create issue (the mock receiver locally).

nodes.name: Queued for Daily Digest
nodes.notes: LOW alerts are already in alert_log; the digest workflow sends them once a day.

nodes.name: No Notification
nodes.notes: SUPPRESS (duplicate in window), LOG_ONLY (recovery with nothing open) or a replayed event.

nodes.name: Slack Result
nodes.notes: Turns the slack success or error output into one delivery_log row.

nodes.name: Jira Result
nodes.notes: Turns the jira success or error output into one delivery_log row.

nodes.name: Email Result
nodes.notes: Turns the email success or error output into one delivery_log row.

meta.description: Receives pipeline failure / SLA events, classifies severity, de-duplicates, logs to Postgres and routes CRITICAL to Slack+Jira+email, HIGH to Slack+Jira, LOW to the daily digest.
